# norm bearer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:normBearer`](gmeow-normBearer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/normBearer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent the norm binds. NOT functional: a norm may bind several named bearers. ABSENT means the norm binds everyone in its issuer's scope — the [`gmeow:ruleAssignee`](gmeow-ruleAssignee.md) convention (rights module), preserved by the graft.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:normBearer`](gmeow-normBearer.md) from [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name a specific agent a norm binds when the norm targets named bearers rather than everyone in the issuer's scope.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it when the norm binds everyone (leave it absent — absence means universal scope) and avoid forcing one bearer, since a norm may bind several.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:normBearer`](gmeow-normBearer.md) to each bound [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); the rights graft's [`gmeow:ruleAssignee`](gmeow-ruleAssignee.md) specializes it, so rights-side assignees surface here by inheritance.
